title: Fleet error catalog v1
description: One entry per operator-visible error condition in the trading fleet: what the code does today, whether a human could decide anything different, which risk tier that puts it in, and which phase the change lands in.

risk_tiers.description: R0..R4, from 'log only' to 'a human must act'. Keys are fixed; the descriptions are the authoritative definition.

notifies.description: Sends a DECISION REQUEST: the human is being asked to choose something. Never true together with audit_notice.

audit_notice.description: Sends an AFTER-THE-FACT AUDIT NOTICE: tells the human what was already done, asks nothing of them. Only meaningful for a tier that executes automatically without notifying.

projects.description: Project key -> repository name. Keys match ops-notify's target keys so a catalog entry can be joined to a notification axis without a second mapping table.

code.description: Stable fleet-wide identifier: <project prefix>.<CONDITION>. Never reused for a different condition once published.

sources.description: file:line of every call site this condition is raised from. Repo-relative, except 'fleet' entries which are repo-qualified.

current.description: What the code does TODAY, before any phase-4+ change.

latch.description: Current latch reason string, or null when this condition does not latch.

notify.description: Current notification event name plus its severity, or null when no notifier exists.

unit_exit.description: Non-zero process exit code used as a second notification channel, or null.

verdict.description: Answer to the project's governing test: does this error let a human make a decision different from what automation would do anyway? No -> MECHANICAL.

resume.description: How a latch for this condition is cleared. 'two_stage_fingerprint' is momentum's existing gate: --confirm must match the live latch fingerprint, and a matching ledger row makes a second clear a no-op.

operator_message.description: Plain-language text sent to the operator when this condition notifies (Phase 7b): what happened, which way the fix goes, and the concrete steps. Optional per entry -- written when a strategy's notifications are wired to ops-notify -- but when present all three parts must be non-empty. Never on an R0 entry, which notifies nobody.
